text:
maria: FYI - FinancialBridge wants a 3-week POC next month. Requirements: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning for ~40k users (initial import + delta), group->role RBAC mapping, and domain verification for their primary + billing subdomain. They asked for hosted vs short Dedicated pricing. Can @tim and @sara validate infra/security blockers?

tim: Quick checks: who controls billing subdomain? delegated? That affects TXT verify vs CNAME. Also need peak auth rps to size Dedicated.

maria: They control both domains but billing is on a partner-managed zone (they can request DNS change). Peak auth ~600 rps during batch runs, baseline ~120. MAU ~900k.

sara: Security: they require signed assertions (RSA-SHA256) and prefer encrypted responses. NameID should be persistent to avoid email churn. They may send memberOf attribute as fallback for RBAC.

tim: SCIM: 40k bulk import needs chunking. Recommend using our bulk import or paging in 5k chunks. Prefer PATCH for membership updates. Example fetch: 
GET /scim/v2/Users?startIndex=1&count=200&filter=meta.lastModified gt 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z
Auth: Bearer <token>

mag: For RBAC, ask them to supply a CSV mapping scim_group->platform_role. That keeps audit trail. Sample row: payments,operator.

maria: They also asked about IP allowlisting and VPC peering for Dedicated. Any constraints?

tim: We can do VPC peering + allowlist for Dedicated. Hosted supports IP allowlist but not customer HSM or KMS. KMS requirement pushes to Private.

infra-bot: Created ticket RDW-5002 (owner: tim) - checklist: SAML metadata, SCIM staging creds, 50-sample CSV, group mappings, domain TXT/CNAME, MAU/peak RPS, KMS need.

maria: Next steps: I'll request SAML metadata and a 50-user CSV. Tim/Sara please prepare short notes on SCIM throttling/backoff and SAML checklist for the kickoff call.

tim: I'll post backoff guidance (exponential backoff + Retry-After) and a simple capacity estimate before Wed EOD.

sara: I'll draft SAML answers and minimum config list.

maria: Great — schedule call Wed 11am PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
